purpose: Teach: 岩波書店/ワーキング/大学院生/読了/セーブ/日弁連/コンディション/クラッシュ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 岩波書店の新刊フェアに協賛しましょう
lines.en: Let's sponsor the Iwanami publishing new-release fair.
lines.style: Clear, forward-moving. Measured cadence, as if reading from prepared notes. Slight lift at the period — suggesting this is the opening of a meeting agenda.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ワーキングタイムの管理を厳格化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll tighten up the working-time management.
lines.style: Prompt, affirming. Quick acknowledgment without hesitation. Businesslike, not enthusiastic — the tone of someone noting action items.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 大学院生向けのキャリア相談会を開きましょう
lines.en: We should also hold a career guidance session for graduate students.
lines.style: Same measured opening as the first proposal. Deliberate. The 'also' carries a sense of building the agenda. Slight pause before the key phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マニュアル読了テストを実施します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement a manual-completion test.
lines.style: Clipped affirmation. Efficient tone — he's already moving to the next task. No elaboration, just confirmation and action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: セーブポイントを設定して進めましょう
lines.en: Let's set checkpoints as we move forward.
lines.style: Directional, as before. Calm authority. The language suggests strategic planning rather than crisis mode. Steady pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日弁連の弁護士をご紹介します
lines.en: Yes. I'll introduce a lawyer from the Japan Federation of Bar Associations.
lines.style: Brief, professional note-taking tone. He's completing the thought quickly and accurately. No flourish — just competent follow-through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員のコンディション調査を匿名で実施しましょう
lines.en: Let's conduct an anonymous survey of staff well-being.
lines.style: Measured proposal, with weight on the word 'anonymous.' This signals care and discretion. Clear diction. The tone suggests this is important.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。クラッシュ時の連絡網を見直します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the emergency contact list.
lines.style: Final note. Still professional, but a shade warmer — the weight of the topic (contingency) lands quietly. Closure without punctuation feels right here.
